content_zh:
臭种地的！再给你三天时间，要是不把这个月的地税交了！送你去阎王！”
一间茅草屋里，一个身穿铠甲的官兵神情凶恶，脚下踩着一个身穿粗布衣的少年。
少年鼓起勇气，“可……可是，月初已经把下个月的交了……”
“嘭！”
少年还没说完，官兵一脚踢在了他的脸上，牙齿踢掉好几颗，鲜血直流。
“还敢废话！告诉你，记住，三天后不把地税交出来，老子弄死你！”
官兵冷冷地威胁了一句，转身离去，去其他家收地税。
少年紧握着拳头，身体颤抖，不是害怕，而是愤怒。
他叫江平安，十四岁，住在大河村，世代务农。
本来日子还过得去，但数年前国家打仗，开始疯狂征税。
地税、人头税、进城税……总之，就是要钱。
母亲因为劳作过度累死，父亲为了去打猎，被山上的猛虎吃掉。
如今，他们家只剩下他自己，可这些人还是不想放过自己这个只有十四岁的孩子。
他好累，想去死，可父母之前不停叮嘱，要他活下去。
他不知道活下去的意义是什么，如果非说有目标，那就是弄死这些欺压百姓的混蛋。
可是，他才十四，长年营养不良，身体极为瘦弱，根本对付不了这些学武的士兵，听说一些士兵还拥有仙人一样的力量。
江平安一瘸一拐的站起身，一天没吃饭，加上被殴打一顿，身体有些撑不住了。
茅草屋里空空荡荡，桌子板凳，能卖的都卖了。
江平安的目光望向灶台旁边的破盆。
这是家里唯一剩下的东西，是父亲在河边捡来的青铜盆，上面布满裂痕，平常用来盛水，比脑袋大了一点。

江平安一瘸一瘸地走到破青铜盆前，只剩下这一个能卖的了，也不知道能卖几个铜币。
不管怎么样，先去卖掉，换几个烧饼，就算死，也要当个饱死鬼。
就在他抱起青铜盆时，鲜血滴在上面，一道璀璨的青光从盆内闪过。
江平安愣了愣，怎么回事？青铜盆为什么会发光？
难道是被打得出现了幻觉？
“平安哥！”
这时，门口出现一个虎头虎脑的小女孩，女孩八岁左右，衣服缝缝补补，勉强能遮住身体。
“虎妞。”江平安下意识地回应。
对方其实叫李月月，虎妞是小名。
李月月快速跑了进来，摊开雪白的小手，将一枚铜币快速放在江平安手里的盆中，奶声奶气地说道：
“平安哥，这是我偷我爸爸的，你要赶紧把税凑齐呦。”
紧接着，她在怀里掏出一个热腾腾的半个馒头塞进对方手里，“快点吃呦，我刚剩下的。”
“不行，这钱……”
江平安还没说完，李月月就笑嘻嘻地跑了。
看着面前的一枚铜币和半个馒头，即使被官兵殴打也没哭的江平安，此刻眼中浮现泪水。
世上不缺锦上添花，缺少的是雪中送炭。
在这种绝望的环境下，还有人关心自己，那种感觉难以形容。
突然，一道青色的光芒在青铜盆中闪过。
紧接着，江平安错愕的一幕发生了，破烂的青铜盆中忽然出现好多铜币。
他愣了好一会儿，猛地打了一个哆嗦，谨慎地他快速将门关上。

重新低头看向青铜盆，里面的铜币还在！
幻觉？不，绝对不是！
江平安颤抖着手伸进青铜盆中，将里面的铜币捡出来。
content_en:
Stinky ground! I’ll give you three more days, if you don’t pay this month’s land tax! Send you to the King of Hell! "
In a thatched house, an officer and soldier in armor looked fierce, with a young man wearing coarse cloth stepping on his feet.
The young man mustered up his courage, "But...but, I have already handed in next month's payment at the beginning of the month..."
“Bang! "
Before the boy could finish speaking, an officer kicked him in the face, knocking out several teeth and causing blood to flow.
"How dare you talk nonsense! Let me tell you, remember, if you don’t pay the land tax in three days, I will kill you! "
The officers and soldiers threatened him coldly, turned around and left to collect land taxes from other houses.
The boy clenched his fists and his body was shaking, not with fear, but with anger.
His name is Jiang Pingan, he is fourteen years old and lives in Dahe Village. He has been farming for generations.
Life used to be okay, but a few years ago the country went to war and began to impose taxes like crazy.
Land tax, poll tax, town tax... in short, they cost money.
My mother died of overwork and my father was eaten by a tiger in the mountains while going hunting.
Now, he was the only one left in their family, but these people still didn't want to let go of their only fourteen-year-old child.
He was so tired and wanted to die, but his parents kept telling him to live.
He didn't know what the meaning of living was. If he had a goal, it would be to kill these bastards who oppressed the people.
However, he was only fourteen. He had been malnourished for many years and his body was extremely thin. He was unable to deal with these martial arts soldiers. I heard that some soldiers had the power of immortals.
Jiang Ping'an limped to his feet. He hadn't eaten for a day and was beaten, so his body couldn't hold on any longer.
The thatched hut was empty, and all the tables and benches that could be sold were sold.
Jiang Ping'an looked at the broken basin next to the stove.
This is the only thing left in the family. It is a bronze basin that my father picked up from the river. It is full of cracks and is usually used to hold water. It is a little bigger than my head.
Jiang Ping'an limped to the broken bronze basin. This was the only one left that could be sold, and he didn't know how many copper coins it could be sold for.
No matter what, I'll sell it first and exchange it for a few sesame seeds. Even if I die, I'll still be a dead ghost.
Just as he picked up the bronze basin, blood dripped on it, and a bright blue light flashed from the basin.
Jiang Ping'an was stunned, what's going on? Why does the bronze basin shine?
Could it be that he was hallucinating after being beaten?
"Brother Ping An! "
At this time, a little girl appeared at the door with a tiger-like head. The girl was about eight years old. Her clothes were so patched that they could barely cover her body.
“Hu Niu. "Jiang Ping'an responded subconsciously.
The other party's actual name is Li Yueyue, and Huniu is her nickname.
Li Yueyue ran in quickly, spread out her white hands, quickly placed a copper coin in the basin in Jiang Ping'an's hand, and said in a sweet voice:
"Brother Ping'an, I stole this from my father, you have to collect the taxes quickly. "
Then, she took out a hot half steamed bun from her arms and stuffed it into the other person's hand, "Eat quickly, I just left it. "
"No, this money..."
Before Jiang Pingan finished speaking, Li Yueyue ran away with a smile.
Looking at a copper coin and half a steamed bun in front of him, Jiang Pingan, who did not cry even when he was beaten by officers and soldiers, now had tears in his eyes.
There is no shortage of icing on the cake in the world, but what is missing is timely help.
In such a desperate environment, there are still people who care about me. The feeling is indescribable.
Suddenly, a green light flashed in the bronze basin.
Immediately afterwards, Jiang Ping'an was shocked. Many copper coins suddenly appeared in the broken bronze basin.
He was stunned for a while, shuddered violently, and cautiously closed the door quickly.
He lowered his head and looked at the bronze basin again. The copper coins in it were still there!
Hallucination? No, absolutely not!
Jiang Ping'an reached into the bronze basin with trembling hands and picked out the copper coins inside.
